review_story.summary: A 28-second looping product-range ad for 'Just the Fun Part' chocolate-filled mini waffle cones: four flavour cards built on one template, ending with the slogan 'Only The Best Part Of The Sundae Cone
review_story.hook: 0-1 s: no intro; the first frame is already a full product card (hazelnut pile + pouch on brown/green) with 'Filled with Hazelnut cream & Milk chocolate' readable at once.
highlights: One template, four colourways (0-20.8 s): only the colours, ingredient pile and pouch change, so viewers compare flavours at a glance and the production cost is minimal.

Ingredient-first composition in every card: the raw ingredients (hazelnuts, pumpkin and cinnamon, marshmallows, mint and dark chocolate) sit next to the pack and sell the taste before the packaging do
Pouch slides out from behind the colour seam (e.g. 1.4-3.7 s): a simple mask trick that gives depth and motion without any 3D.
Seamless loop (27.7-27.88 s): the end card wipes straight back into the first frame, so on autoplay feeds the ad replays without a visible restart.

camera.setups: No camera: everything is a 2D motion-graphics composite of cut-out photos/packshots on flat colour panels.

editing.editing: 4 flavour cards of about 5-6 s each, joined by panel-block wipes, then a 7 s kinetic-type end card that wipes back to the first card for a seamless loop.

format.format: 9:16 product-range promo / Pinterest-style ad, no voice-over, music bed + whoosh/pop SFX on transitions and text.
